title.narrative: PBF-MoH Project

description.narrative: A total of 1,311,317 people living in the catchment area of the 46 targeted Health Facilities in the 3 (Akaki Kality, Halaba, and Sitti) project Zones/Sub-city will benefit from the project implementation.

General: Improved availability and accessibility of good quality healthcare at primary and secondary levels in the geographical areas (one zone in Somali, one zone in Central Ethiopia, and one sub-city in Addis Ababa), and a stronger health system at large, which supports the progressive realization of Universal Health Coverage (UHC).
Specific 1: Improved health service delivery in one Zone (Somali), one Zone (Central Ethiopia), and one sub-city (Addis Ababa).
Specific 2: Improved governance of health service delivery.
Specific 3: An enhanced health information system

In 2015, Cordaid and the Oromia Regional Health Bureau introduced PBF in the Ethiopian health sector, in the Borana zone, while in 2019 a second PBF project started in the Jimma zone. This expansion was made possible by the financial support of the Embassy of the Kingdom of The Netherlands (EKN) in Addis Ababa, which subsequently took over the funding of the PBF intervention in the Borana zone. From July 2021, the project covers 100% of the Health Facilities in Jimma and Borana. The project scope included 11 hospitals, 165 health centers, and 737 health posts, with a total population of 4 296 485 in Jimma and Borana as of December 2021.
Cordaid has engaged intensively with Ethiopian health policymakers over the last few years – including training, workshops, technical assistance, and international study tours within and outside the country to advance the PBF agenda in Ethiopia. Based on these interactions and positive results from Borana and Jimma as well as from the growing evidence of PBF in other countries, the Ethiopian Ministry of Health (MoH) has included PBF as one of the key health financing strategies under its second Health Sector Transformation Plan (HSTP). This project is an institutionalized PBF pilot in three additional regions (Addis Ababa, Central Ethiopia, and Somali) that work towards the realization of the HSTP II.
